findings.title: Opening a window steals the focus from a non-modal editable field (scratchpad note)
findings.scoreReason: The race is real (openWindowWhenReady retries for up to 5 s and takeFocus only checks for aria-modal), but every caller starts from a dialog the user just submitted, so typing a scratchpad note in that gap is unlikely; the guard is a few lines and needs care not to block Scratchpads.tsx:151, which opens a window on purpose, so it belongs in the review's final comment, not in its own work item.

findings.title: Ctrl+N to the window already open skips openWindow and gives no focus back
findings.scoreReason: Correct: shortcuts.ts:147 skips openWindow for the window already open, which contradicts the new web-standards.md:33 line, but the user-facing cost is small and the fix is a single line (passing r.pane so the pane is kept), better done now than scheduled.
